test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following pie chart represents the data of movies released in a city throughout a year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77a7aa0f6c94433b7f0bab00558b2867102614590fb005461fb0c332bf528955.png] 

The combined angle made by Jan-Mar and Jul-Sep is ____________ than the combined angle made by Apr-Jun and Oct-Dec.
solution:
**Calculation:**

The combined angle made by Jan-Mar and Jul-Sep = 150 + 170 

⇒ 320

The combined angle made by Apr-Jun and Oct-Dec = 210 + 190

⇒ 400

Less = 400 - 320 = 80

According to the question,

Angle = (80/720)360

⇒ 40o

**∴ The combined angle made by Jan-Mar and Jul-Sep is 40o less than the combined angle made by Apr-Jun and Oct-Dec.**
